name: Nader Schasschule
original_name: ネイダー・シャズクール
source:
Member of the Lemures.
A traitor who opposes Huey and intends to overthrow him. He tried to recruit allies to join the Russo Family, but was stopped by Goose.

[Translated from in-game profile]
